description: This file defines a PHP script for rendering a subpanel view in SuiteCRM, specifically for displaying users related to roles. It initializes the interface, loads templates, and processes a list of users associated with a role.

classes.name: ListView
classes.description: A class responsible for rendering list views using templates in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: initNewXTemplate
methods.description: Initializes a new XTemplate with the specified template file and language strings.

methods.name: xTemplateAssign
methods.description: Assigns variables to the template for rendering.

methods.name: setHeaderTitle
methods.description: Sets the title displayed in the list view header.

methods.name: setQuery
methods.description: Defines the query parameters for fetching list data.

methods.name: setHeaderText
methods.description: Sets custom HTML or text in the list view header.

methods.name: processListView
methods.description: Processes and renders the list view based on the data and templates.
